title: Space Year (FINALE)
about: A reflection on how 22 days at State Arts-In changed my life and gave me a second family.
description: Serving as the closing track of the album, this song looks back on every story, friendship, and lesson from my first State Arts-In. From building spaceships and backstage projects to the people who welcomed me, each memory became part of a week that quietly changed the direction of my life. It's a tribute to the places, moments, and friendships that continue to shine long after the lights went out.
lyrics: A quiet kid beneath the lights.
A world of stages, tools and songs,
Yet every road I followed there
Greg said, "Sure, come help me build."
Jules climbed ladders toward the sky.
More than lumber, lights and paint.
More than radios and code names,
More than things that time can't save.
The place my life began to bend.
I came to build a spaceship.
Ghost still walks those hidden hallways.
Duck Duck Grey Duck still echoes
With Mom's quiet "Thank you" at the end.
But the people that you meet
Where a sheltered boy could grow.
More than they could ever know.
I came to build a spaceship...
I left with another family there.
